items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Like Lonnie Furgo. Young ones, yeah. He don't speak.

ctx.x: Do you call yourself a Creole?

Yeah, but I don't, I can't talk that language anymore. No, but I mean there's a lot of people that don't talk that language. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Like Lonnie Furgo. Young ones, yeah. He don't speak. No, the young people who avoided talking in that Creole stuff. The grandparents and all were talking. Yeah, but... All of my parents were talking, but none of us.
But they didn't, you didn't ever hear any Creole singers?
